messages:
sarah-pm: Hey all — quick ask. Can we slot a cross-functional roadmap + RFC review next week? I want product + eng + infra in the same room to walk the priority list and a couple RFCs. Proposed agenda (30m total):

1) Roadmap priorities & decision log review — sarah-pm (10m)
2) RFC: KV cache + batching changes — leo-eng (12m)
3) Canary/rollout plan + SLO implications — mira (6m)

Times: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 13:00-13:30 PT. PT/ET friendly please. Who can own each item and which slot works? @leo-eng @mira @alex-infra

leo-eng: I can own the RFC + quick demo. Tue works for me. For the RFC, request we allocate ~5 extra minutes for Qs. Also need to sync with infra on kernel selection notes.

mira: Can take the canary/rollout. Wed is slightly better for me (afternoon). I'll bring the rollout checklist and the metrics we want to watch. :white_check_mark:

alex-infra: Wed 13 PT is rough for infra team due to deploys. Tue 10 PT safer. If we do Tue, I can prepare a 2-slide note on routing/fallbacks. Also need to flag that the KV cache RFC may change perf numbers — will call that out.

jamal: Tie-breaker — I prefer Tue too. If we do Tue, add a 2-min 'rollbacks' quick item.

carol-sales: Heads up — product leadership would like a 1-min summary of customer impact on Dedicated pricing; can summarize if time permits.

sarah-pm: OK sounds like Tue 10 PT is the tentative winner. Agenda owners: sarah-pm (priorities), leo-eng (RFC), mira (rollout), alex-infra (infra notes), carol-sales (pricing blip). Jamal will own rollback notes. I'll book 30m and add a follow-up doc.

calendar-bot: Poll created — Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PT (Yes: 4, No: 1), Wed 2026-03-25 13:00 PT (Yes: 1, No: 3). Meeting created: "Roadmap & RFC review" — 30m. Invitees: sarah-pm, leo-eng, mira, alex-infra, jamal, carol-sales. Link: https://calendar.company/evt/abc123

leo-eng: Thanks — I'll upload the RFC draft to the meeting doc and tag specific lines for review. Please add any pre-read notes in the doc.

mira: I'll add the rollout checklist and expected dashboards. See you Tue. :rocket:
